title: Stress and Diabetes Risk
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to stress and diabetes risk.
evidence_strength: Moderate evidence supports the role of chronic stress as an independent risk factor for type 2 diabetes, with strong mechanistic basis from hormonal and inflammatory pathways. However, variability in stress measurement and confounding factors limit the conclusiveness of some epidemiological studies. Behavioral stress reduction interventions show promise but need further large-scale trials to establish efficacy specifically for diabetes prevention.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
